rules.name: No leftover placeholder
rules.rationale: Placeholders (TODO, FIXME, foobar, lorem ipsum) must never survive into a shared draft — they signal an unfinished thought.

examples.after: We evaluate on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet.

rules.name: No borrowed metaphors
rules.rationale: A dead metaphor signals borrowed thinking. Replace it with the literal claim it stood in for, which is almost always more specific.

rules.name: Don't open with filler
rules.rationale: An opening filler phrase spends the reader's attention before the sentence says anything. Delete it and check whether the sentence still works.

prefixes: It is important to note that

examples.before: It is important to note that the estimator is unbiased.

rules.name: Cut empty intensifiers
rules.rationale: Empty intensifiers (very, really, quite, rather) pad a claim without adding information. A precise word or number makes them unnecessary.
